title: Humanizer & Anti-Slop Skills
description: Open-source humanizer and anti-slop skills, security-graded: make AI-written text, code and UI read like a person made it (blader/humanizer, Humanizer-zh, taste-skill), and detect AI tells. Vet before you install.

method.h2: How we judge humanizer skills: the two-layer method
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评去 AI 味 skill：两层法
method.thesis: AI-written text gives itself away on two layers. The surface is word choice and punctuation: "delve", "tapestry", em-dashes, stock phrases. Underneath are the choices: spelling out the lesson, tying every thread up neatly, gesturing at "great works" instead of naming one. Most humanizer skills scrub the surface. A 2026 study of 61,608 stories (StoryScope, University of Maryland and Google DeepMind, COLM 2026) found that this barely matters: after a rewriting tool removed surface artifacts from AI stories, a classifier that looks only at narrative structure still caught 93.9% of them, against 95.5% before. So we judge a humanizer by which layer it reaches.
method.thesis_zh: AI 写的文字会在两层露馅。表层是用词和标点："delve""tapestry"、破折号、套话。下面一层是写作上的选择：把道理讲穿、把每条线都收得整整齐齐、泛泛提一句"经典作品"而不点名。大多数去 AI 味 skill 只擦表层。2026 年一项覆盖 61,608 篇小说的研究（StoryScope，马里兰大学与 Google DeepMind，COLM 2026）发现，这几乎没用：用改写工具去掉 AI 小说的表层痕迹之后，一个只看叙事结构的分类器仍然识别出 93.9%，改写前是 95.5%。所以我们按一个 skill 改到哪一层来评它。
columns: 只改这一层会留下什么

routes.name: Words and punctuation
routes.how_zh: "delve""tapestry"、破折号、固定的开头和结尾套话。
routes.gain: Fading on its own: newer models use far fewer em-dashes, and fine-tuning on human style cut AI detection on creative writing from 97% to 3%.
routes.gain_zh: 本身就在消失：新模型的破折号已大幅减少；用人类文风微调后，创意写作的 AI 检出率从 97% 降到 3%。
routes.cost: Easy to fix and easy to fake; fixing it changes nothing else.
routes.cost_zh: 好改也好装；改了它，别的都没变。

routes.name: Phrasing
routes.how_zh: 陈词滥调、辞藻堆砌、重复解释。
routes.gain: In the study, a tool rewrote seven kinds of such artifacts; structure-based detection fell only from 95.5% to 93.9%.
routes.gain_zh: 研究里用工具改写了七类这样的痕迹，基于结构的识别率只从 95.5% 降到 93.9%。
routes.cost: The text reads smoother but makes the same choices.
routes.cost_zh: 读起来更顺，但做的还是同样的选择。

routes.name: Structure
routes.how: States its own theme (77% of AI stories vs 52% of human ones), resolves into acceptance (47% vs 27%), no subplots (79% vs 57%), emotion through bodily sensation (81% vs 38%), vague allusions instead of named works (72% vs 50%), rarely addresses the reader (7% vs 28%).
routes.how_zh: 直接点明主题（AI 77%，人类 52%）、以接受与和解收尾（47% 对 27%）、没有支线（79% 对 57%）、用身体感受写情绪（81% 对 38%）、泛泛提及而不点名具体作品（72% 对 50%）、几乎不对读者说话（7% 对 28%）。
routes.gain: Narrative choices alone separate human from AI fiction at 93.2% macro-F1, with every style signal removed.
routes.gain_zh: 去掉所有文风信号，只靠叙事选择就能以 93.2% 的 macro-F1 区分人写和 AI 写的小说。
routes.cost: This is the layer that persists. Changing it takes a real rewrite: drop the stated moral, leave an ending open, name the specific thing.
routes.cost_zh: 这一层才会留下来。要改它得真改写：删掉讲出来的道理、让结尾留白、把泛指换成具体的名字。

method.gap: The study measured fiction. For posts, emails, reports and docs we apply the same split as a working rule: we have not measured it on non-fiction. The page also lists code and UI tools; there the surface is comment bloat or a default gradient and the structure is what the code or the screen actually does, which is our analogy, not the study's.
method.gap_zh: 这项研究测的是小说。对帖子、邮件、报告和文档，我们把同样的分层当作工作规则来用，但没有在非虚构文本上测过。这一页还收了代码和界面类工具：那里的表层是冗余注释或默认渐变，结构是代码或界面实际做了什么。这是我们的类比，不是研究的结论。

next_stop.who_zh: 你自己的草稿，不想读起来千篇一律

next_stop.pick: A tool that reaches structure (drops stated morals, keeps endings open, asks for specifics), then a human edit
next_stop.pick_zh: 能改到结构层的工具（删道理、留结尾、要具体），再加人工编辑

next_stop.pick: A Chinese-first tool; English word lists do not carry over
next_stop.pick_zh: 中文优先的工具；英文的词表搬不过来

next_stop.pick: A slop detector, read as a list of things to look at, not a verdict

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every humanizer
每个去 AI 味 skill 我们问四个问题

questions.q: Layer: does it only swap words and punctuation, or does it change phrasing and structure?
questions.q_zh: 层次：只换词换标点，还是会改措辞和结构？

questions.q: Meaning: does it keep facts, numbers and names exactly as they were?
questions.q_zh: 意思：事实、数字、名字是否原样保留？

questions.q: Specificity: does it push toward concrete, named details instead of vague gestures?
questions.q_zh: 具体：是否把泛泛的说法换成具体的、点得出名字的细节？

questions.q: Evidence: does it show what it changed and why (a diff, a report), so you can check it?
questions.q_zh: 证据：是否说明改了什么、为什么改（对照、报告），让你能核对？

floor_activity: while they rewrite or check text, code or UI
改写或检查文字、代码、界面时的行为

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, what does it change.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、它改的是什么。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six types (writing, detectors, Chinese text, code, UI, style rules), so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六种类型之一（写作、检测、中文、代码、界面、写作规则），可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 11 red-flag categories, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 11 类风险对每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: We have not yet run these humanizers on a shared test text; the layers come from the study, and which layer each tool reaches comes from what it says it does.
not_done.item_zh: 我们还没有用同一份测试文本实跑这些 skill；分层来自研究，每个工具改到哪一层来自它自己的说明。

not_done.item: This page is not a guide to passing AI detectors. A humanizer that only scrubs the surface will not hide AI authorship from a structure-based check, per the study above.
not_done.item_zh: 这一页不是教你绕过 AI 检测。按上面的研究，只擦表层的 humanizer 骗不过基于结构的检测。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

It is a single SKILL.md of instructions with no scripts, published in anthropics/skills and also as a plugin in the claude-plugins-official marketplace. It asks Claude to choose a deliberate visual direction for each brief, from typeface and palette to layout, and names the habits that make a page look AI-generated: a cream background with a terracotta accent, one highlighted word in a headline, 01/02/03 markers on content that is not a sequence.

In Claude Code, install it with the command below. The community skills listed after it push the same idea further: the taste skills set a design direction before any code is written, and others add reference images, design-system specs or an audit pass that rewrites AI-looking UI. method.h2: How we judge PPT skills: the delivery-chain method
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 PPT skill：交付链方法
method.thesis: A deck is finished when you hand it over, not when the agent writes the last slide. The best PPT skill is the one that leaves you the least rework before that point. GitHub stars measure how good a skill looks and how far it spreads; they do not measure how much work it saves you, so we read what each skill actually produces before we rank it.
method.thesis_zh: 一份 deck 不是 agent 写完最后一页就算完成，而是交出去才算完成。最好的 PPT skill，是在交出去之前留给你返工最少的那一个。GitHub 星数衡量的是一个 skill 看起来多好、传得多广，衡量不了它帮你省了多少事，所以我们先读懂每个 skill 实际产出什么，再排序。

routes.name: Native PPTX
routes.how: The agent writes the PowerPoint file itself, object by object.
routes.how_zh: agent 直接写 PowerPoint 文件，一个对象一个对象地放。
routes.gain: Every word stays editable in PowerPoint, Keynote or WPS, so a colleague can pick it up.
routes.gain_zh: 每个字都能在 PowerPoint、Keynote、WPS 里改，同事能接着改。
routes.cost: Layouts are limited to what code can place; decks tend to look plainer.
routes.cost_zh: 版式受限于代码能摆出来的样子，往往偏朴素。

routes.name: Web slides
routes.how: The agent writes HTML and CSS, and you present from the browser.
routes.how_zh: agent 写 HTML 和 CSS，你在浏览器里放映。
routes.gain: The most design freedom and animation; the most-starred PPT skills are on this route.
routes.gain_zh: 设计自由度和动画最强；星数最高的 PPT skill 都在这条路线上。
routes.cost: Turning it into a .pptx loses fidelity.

routes.name: Image-first
routes.how: An image model paints each slide.
routes.how_zh: 由图像模型逐页画出来。
routes.cost: The text is pixels: you cannot fix a typo without redrawing the slide.
routes.cost_zh: 字是像素：错一个字就得重画整页。

method.gap: The two routes that look best cannot hand over an editable .pptx, and most people still have to. That gap is where this field is moving: converters that turn slide images back into editable PowerPoint (image-to-editable-ppt-skill), generators that draw a deck first and rebuild it as PPTX (GordenSuperPPTSkills), and pipelines that take a document straight to native slides (ppt-master). Documents-to-slides tools and all-in-one frameworks sit outside the three routes, so the counts above do not add up to the whole page.
method.gap_zh: 最好看的两条路线交不出可编辑的 .pptx，而大多数人最后还是得交 .pptx。这道鸿沟正是这个领域在往前走的方向：把幻灯片图片转回可编辑 PowerPoint 的转换器（image-to-editable-ppt-skill）、先画图再重建成 PPTX 的生成器（GordenSuperPPTSkills），以及从文档直接生成原生幻灯片的流水线（ppt-master）。文档转幻灯片的工具和综合框架不属于这三条路线，所以上表的数字加起来不等于整页。

next_stop.who: A colleague will edit it after you
next_stop.who_zh: 之后要交给同事接着改

next_stop.who: You will present it yourself, from a browser or a link
next_stop.who_zh: 你自己拿浏览器或链接来讲

next_stop.who: It becomes a social post or a cover image
You must hand in a .pptx but want it to look designed
next_stop.pick: Web or image-first, then a converter, and one more review pass
next_stop.pick_zh: 网页或图片优先，再加转换器，多做一轮检查

questions.q: Story: does it plan the storyline (an outline, SCQA, a pyramid) before it draws anything?
questions.q_zh: 叙事：动手画之前，会不会先排故事线（大纲、SCQA、金字塔）？

questions.q: Layout system: does it ship fixed templates or a theme system, so slide 12 matches slide 2?
questions.q_zh: 版式：有没有固定模板或主题体系，保证第 12 页和第 2 页风格一致？

questions.q: Editability: is the output native and editable, editable in the browser, or a picture?
questions.q_zh: 可改：交付物是原生可编辑、浏览器里可改，还是一张图？

questions.q: Self-check: does it render its own output and fix what it sees? PPTAgent, for one, renders the slides, has a vision model review the images, and revises.
questions.q_zh: 自检：会不会把自己的产出渲染出来、看到问题自己改？比如 PPTAgent 会把幻灯片渲染出来，交给视觉模型看图审查，再修改。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count, not only popular repos) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, what does it produce.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数，不只看热门仓库）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、产出什么。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six types, so you can filter by route.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六种类型之一，你可以按路线筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 11 red-flag categories, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 11 类风险对每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: We have not installed and run every skill end to end; the routes and questions above come from reading what each one says it produces.
not_done.item_zh: 我们没有逐个安装、端到端实跑每个 skill；上面的路线和问题来自读每个 skill 自己写明的产出。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

extra_faq.qZh: 歸藏(guizang)PPT skill 是什么?

extra_faq.a: Three ways: give the agent skills for your vault (kepano/obsidian-skills, by Obsidian's CEO), run the agent inside Obsidian with a plugin (YishenTu/claudian embeds Claude Code or Codex; logancyang/obsidian-copilot runs several agents), or connect any assistant through an MCP server (MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian).
extra_faq.qZh: 怎么把 Claude Code 和 Obsidian 一起用?
extra_faq.aZh: 三种方式:给 agent 装上操作库的 skill(kepano/obsidian-skills,出自 Obsidian CEO);用插件把 agent 装进 Obsidian(YishenTu/claudian 内嵌 Claude Code 或 Codex,logancyang/obsidian-copilot 可运行多个 agent);或通过 MCP 服务连接任意 AI 助手(MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian)。

extra_faq.q: Is there an Obsidian Claude plugin or MCP server on GitHub?
extra_faq.a: Plugins: YishenTu/claudian and logancyang/obsidian-copilot. MCP servers: MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian, which works through the Obsidian Local REST API plugin. For a second brain an agent maintains: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian and breferrari/obsidian-mind. All are in the open-source list zhuyansen/awesome-obsidian-ai-skills on GitHub.
extra_faq.qZh: GitHub 上有 Obsidian 的 Claude 插件或 MCP 服务吗?
extra_faq.aZh: 插件:YishenTu/claudian、logancyang/obsidian-copilot。MCP 服务:MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian,通过 Obsidian Local REST API 插件工作。由 agent 维护的第二大脑:AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian、breferrari/obsidian-mind。它们都收录在 GitHub 开源合集 zhuyansen/awesome-obsidian-ai-skills 里。

title: TypeSafe Jev
serp_subject: TypeSafe Jev Skills, Agents & MCP Servers
description: TypeSafe Jev skills, agents and MCP servers: open-source projects built on TypeSafe's Jev decision model, security-graded: the jev-ultrafast browser agent, openjev, fast-jev-compaction, Jev code review tools and MCP servers. Vet before you install.

extra_faq.q: Where are TypeSafe Jev projects on GitHub?
extra_faq.a: The most-starred are browser-use/jev-ultrafast (a web agent), OpenByteInc/QuantDinger (a trading system with Jev integration), jaredpalmer/kev (a Jev-like family of decision models you can run yourself) and tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction (a Claude Code plugin that compacts context with Jev decisions). Every repo on this page is also in the open-source list zhuyansen/awesome-typesafe-jev on GitHub.
extra_faq.qZh: GitHub 上哪里能找到 TypeSafe Jev 相关项目?
extra_faq.aZh: 星数最高的有:browser-use/jev-ultrafast(网页 agent)、OpenByteInc/QuantDinger(集成 Jev 的交易系统)、jaredpalmer/kev(可自己运行的类 Jev 决策模型)和 tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction(用 Jev 决策压缩上下文的 Claude Code 插件)。本页所有仓库也收录在 GitHub 开源合集 zhuyansen/awesome-typesafe-jev 里。

extra_faq.q: How do developers call the Jev API?
extra_faq.a: Through TypeSafe's own API (POST api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone with model jev-latest) or through OpenRouter. Projects under SDKs, MCP & APIs on this page wrap it for other software, for example realZachi/pg-jev, a PostgreSQL extension that answers plain-language questions about tables.
extra_faq.qZh: 开发者怎么调用 Jev API?
extra_faq.aZh: 可以用 TypeSafe 官方接口(POST api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone,模型 jev-latest),也可以经 OpenRouter 调用。本页「SDK、MCP 与接口」一类的项目把它封装给其他软件用,例如 realZachi/pg-jev,一个能用自然语言查询表的 PostgreSQL 扩展。

extra_faq.q: Where are Claude video skills on GitHub?
extra_faq.a: The most-starred are calesthio/OpenMontage (an agentic video production system), heygen-com/hyperframes (write HTML, render video, built for agents), diffusionstudio/lottie (Lottie animations from Claude Code or Codex) and adithya-s-k/manim_skill (3Blue1Brown-style animations with Manim). extra_faq.qZh: GitHub 上哪里能找到 Claude 视频 skill?
extra_faq.aZh: 星数最高的有:calesthio/OpenMontage(agent 驱动的视频制作系统)、heygen-com/hyperframes(写 HTML 渲染视频,为 agent 设计)、diffusionstudio/lottie(用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成 Lottie 动画)和 adithya-s-k/manim_skill(用 Manim 做 3Blue1Brown 风格动画)。本页所有仓库也收录在 GitHub 开源合集 zhuyansen/awesome-claude-video-skills 里,按类型分组并做了安全评级。

extra_faq.q: Can Claude Code edit existing video?
extra_faq.a: Yes, with an editing skill or agent: FireRedTeam/FireRed-OpenStoryline turns manual editing into an agent workflow, Agentchengfeng/chengfeng-videocut-skills is a video-cutting agent built as Claude Code skills, and 0xsline/OpenChatCut is a local-first conversational editor with a multi-track timeline. They are listed on this page under Editing.
extra_faq.qZh: Claude Code 能剪辑现成的视频吗?
extra_faq.aZh: 可以,用剪辑类的 skill 或 agent:FireRedTeam/FireRed-OpenStoryline 把手工剪辑变成 agent 工作流,Agentchengfeng/chengfeng-videocut-skills 是用 Claude Code skill 做的剪辑 agent,0xsline/OpenChatCut 是本地优先、带多轨时间线的对话式剪辑器。本页把它们归在「剪辑与后期」一类。

title: Claude Code Hooks, Subagents & Statusline
description: Open-source Claude Code hooks, subagents and statuslines, security-graded: hook guards and formatters, specialist agent collections, usage and context status bars. Vet before you install.

extra_faq.q: What are Claude Code hooks used for?
extra_faq.a: Scripts that run on events such as a tool call, a prompt or the end of a turn: blocking risky commands, formatting files after edits, sending notifications, logging. disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery walks through every hook event with working examples; severity1/claude-code-prompt-improver is a hook that improves prompts before Claude sees them.
extra_faq.qZh: Claude Code hooks 有什么用?
extra_faq.aZh: 在工具调用、提交提示、一轮结束等事件上自动运行的脚本:拦截危险命令、编辑后自动格式化、发通知、记日志。disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery 用可运行的例子讲清每一种 hook 事件;severity1/claude-code-prompt-improver 是一个在 Claude 看到之前先改进提示词的 hook。

extra_faq.q: Where can I find a list of Claude Code hooks, subagents and statuslines?
extra_faq.a: Hooks: disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery. Subagents: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents (100+ specialist subagents). Statuslines: jarrodwatts/claude-hud and sirmalloc/ccstatusline. All are in the open-source list zhuyansen/awesome-claude-code-hooks on GitHub, grouped by type and security-graded.
extra_faq.qZh: 哪里能找到 Claude Code hooks、subagents 和 statusline 的合集?
extra_faq.aZh: Hooks:disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery;Subagents:VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents(100 多个专家子代理);状态栏:jarrodwatts/claude-hud、sirmalloc/ccstatusline。它们都收录在 GitHub 开源合集 zhuyansen/awesome-claude-code-hooks 里,按类型分组并做了安全评级。
